thread:
Maya: Dropped a new iteration of the Private setup step focusing on the preflight experience. Instead of a modal we tried an inline live log area. PTAL: https://figma.com/s/live-preflight Luis: Nice. UX question: do we show raw tcp traces or just actionable failures? Raw logs are noisy for product teams. Priya: I vote parsed failures + an expand-to-raw option. Show top 3 actionable items with clear next steps, then the raw log collapsed under "Show full diagnostics". Tom: Accessibility: live updates need an aria-live region for screen readers. But be careful not to flood SR users with every log line. Use polite and batch updates (announce only summary lines and final status). Maya: Good call. Proposed behavior: announce "Preflight running", then only announce "Preflight complete: 2 issues" or "Preflight OK". Details available via file-expand that SR can open. Luis: For visual users, we show a status strip in the stepper: pending -> running (spinner) -> issues / success. Also an inline badge per check (DNS, CIDR, egress, SSH). Priya: Copy tweak: change button from "Run preflight" to "Run connectivity check" — less jargony. Add tooltip: "Simulates control-plane connections from your VPC. Does not modify anything." Tom: ARIA pattern suggestion: use a hidden region with aria-live=polite for state changes and a separate aria-describedby on the log container for the list of failures. Example: ```
Preflight running
    ``` Only populate failures list after run completes. Maya: UX to avoid layout shift: the live log area should have a reserved height with vertical scroll; expanding raw logs should reveal full content in a modal instead of pushing everything down. Luis: Mobile note: keep the "Run connectivity check" sticky at the bottom of the step, so users can re-run without scrolling. Priya: Error copy examples: instead of "connection failed" use "Cannot reach control-plane at control.redwood.ai:443. Check outbound 443 to control.redwood.ai from your CIDR." Add a "Retry diagnostics" CTA that runs targeted checks. KB-bot: Suggested KB links: /kb/vpc-egress, /kb/preflight-troubleshooting, /kb/ssh-setup. Tom: Logging concern: backend streams raw events. Frontend should map event types to localized messages; keep raw event payload for modal export only. No PII in logs. Maya: Agreed. Also add a small copy line: "Export logs (redacted)" when opening raw modal. Luis: Visual polish: use color tokens for badges (neutral/pending, info/running, success, error) and ensure AA contrast for badges' text. Priya: Can we add a tiny inline help link next to step title: "Why we check connectivity?" that opens a KB drawer. Keeps primer out of the way. Maya: Yes — that replaces the big primer. Final checklist: Tom wires aria-live and batching; Luis implements reserved height + sticky run button; Priya writes final microcopy and KB links; Maya will create QA cases (announce behavior, SR friendly, batch updates). Aim to push to staging by Thu. preview-bot: uploaded mock: https://img.redwood.ai/previews/1769994321-live-preflight.png :thumbsup:
